svg.title: Optimal-load bounds versus helper slots: Free and Hierarchical
svg.desc: Seven panels show EP8, EP16, EP32, EP64, EP128, EP256 and EP512, with one through four helper slots per rank. Each panel has its own y-axis range. Blue solid lines with filled circles are Free; orange dashed lines with open squares are Hierarchical with pairs allowed. Lines and markers show mean feasible-plan upper bounds on R*. Shading and capped vertical lines show proven lower to validated upper bounds, not statistical confidence intervals. A dagger on a slot tick marks at least one unresolved layer in either rule. Data use 1536 experts, top-16 routing, Zipf popularity with coefficient of variation 2, 131072 tokens per step, 64 layers per EP and no load relay.

g.text: Each panel has its own y scale.
